objective: Confirm the system detects and rejects a file altered after signing
procedure: Copy a registered clinic file, modify a field, recompute integrity check
expected: verify_against_manifest() returns False with a hash-mismatch message; file not ingested
actual: original_hash=561f1a83def2e605... new_hash=c7fef8b17317cb2c... verify_result=False, detail='HASH MISMATCH: expected 561f1a83def2e605c277d80aa2b5e48f7bf55cd0ef4b2088c052e6dfa1b2c0c6, got c7fef8b17317cb2c797c3b79d12b7bea48fe08e1e66591aa97d3583790331d13'

objective: Confirm tampered files are rejected end-to-end and never reach storage
procedure: Call ingest_file() on the tampered file from TEST-1 using valid clinic credentials
expected: Ingestion pipeline rejects the file before any records are written to the database
actual: ingest_file() result={'status': 'rejected', 'reason': 'HASH MISMATCH: expected 561f1a83def2e605c277d80aa2b5e48f7bf55cd0ef4b2088c052e6dfa1b2c0c6, got c7fef8b17317cb2c797c3b79d12b7bea48fe08e1e66591aa97d3583790331d13'}, records stored under this filename=0

objective: Confirm the system rejects invalid credentials and unknown accounts
procedure: Call authenticate() with a wrong password for a real user, and with a nonexistent username
expected: AuthError raised in both cases; no session/token issued
actual: wrong_password -> AuthError raised: True ('Invalid credentials'); unknown_user -> rejected: True

objective: Confirm role-based access control restricts decryption to the admin role only
procedure: Attempt decrypt_record() as clinic_uploader, auditor, and admin roles
expected: clinic_uploader and auditor are denied (AuthError); admin succeeds
actual: clinic_uploader decrypt blocked=True, auditor decrypt blocked=True, admin decrypt succeeded=True

objective: Confirm patient data is encrypted at rest (no plaintext PII visible in DB storage)
procedure: Read raw encrypted_blob bytes directly from SQLite and search for known plaintext substrings
expected: Zero plaintext matches - all values must be unrecoverable without the encryption key
actual: Scanned 200 encrypted blobs for 5 known plaintext terms. Matches found: 0

objective: Confirm every upload attempt (successful and rejected) is captured in the audit log
procedure: Query the upload_log table and the ingestion.log file after running tests 1-5
expected: Log contains both SUCCESS and REJECTED_* entries with timestamps and actor identity
actual: upload_log status breakdown={'REJECTED_TAMPER': 1, 'SUCCESS': 13}; success_events=13, rejected_events=1; logs/ingestion.log exists=True with 28 lines
